I took WMI v9 out for about 30 minutes on a clear daytime drive.

Overall, both lateral and longitudinal behavior felt quite similar to v8. I didn’t notice any major differences in normal cruising or general stability.

One thing I did notice is that cornering speeds felt slightly higher than v8, to the point where it occasionally felt a bit aggressive and somewhat risky compared to what I’m used to with v8.

For now, I think I’ll continue using v8 as my daily driving model, but I’m looking forward to seeing how v9 evolves with further tuning.
I went back to V8. V9 on my Atlas feels like it lost all the steering tq it had on prior versions. It also tries taking turns too fast coupled with the lower tq and it feels sketchy AF.
